speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe exactly where you feel the pain in your wrist and how it started? Have you noticed a rash or any skin lesions on your arms or hands? Have you had a fever or felt generally unwell recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi infection) presenting with wrist involvement (Lyme arthritis/tenosynovitis).
